changeSet.author: koala
changeSet.comment: Crew membership now follows escrow; workers who never paid into escrow leave existing crews.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE conversation_participants p SET is_deleted = true, deleted_at = now() FROM conversations c JOIN jobs j ON j.id = c.job_id WHERE p.conversation_id = c.id AND p.is_deleted = false AND c.kind = 'GROUP' AND p.user_id <> c.employer_id AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM company_contacts cc WHERE cc.company_id = j.company_id AND cc.user_id = p.user_id AND cc.is_deleted = false) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM job_assignments a WHERE a.job_id = c.job_id AND a.worker_id = p.user_id AND a.is_deleted = false AND a.status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'REJECTED') AND a.payment_status IN ('HELD_IN_ESCROW', 'RELEASED_TO_WORKER'))

changeSet.author: koala
changeSet.comment: Company officers join the crews of their company's jobs that have not yet ended.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO conversation_participants (id, conversation_id, user_id, joined_at, is_deleted, created_at) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), c.id, cc.user_id, now(), false, now() FROM conversations c JOIN jobs j ON j.id = c.job_id JOIN company_contacts cc ON cc.company_id = j.company_id AND cc.is_deleted = false WHERE c.kind = 'GROUP' AND c.is_deleted = false AND (j.end_date_time IS NULL OR j.end_date_time > now()) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM conversation_participants p WHERE p.conversation_id = c.id AND p.user_id = cc.user_id AND p.is_deleted = false)
